a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.title: Indlela Yokuguqula i-HEIC ibe yi-JPG kwifowuni nakwilaptop (Simahla, Ngaphandle kweApp)
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.excerpt: Imifanekiso ye-HEIC ye-iPhone ayivuleki kwi-Windows okanye kwi-Android? Guqula i-HEIC ibe yi-JPG ngemizuzwana, simahla kwaye ungazilayishi iifoto kwiseva.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.body:
I-iPhone igcina iifoto ngohlobo lwe-HEIC kuba incinci kune-JPG kodwa ikumgangatho ofanayo. Ingxaki kukuba izixhobo ezininzi kunye neeapp, ingakumbi i-Windows endala, i-Android, namaphepha ewebhu, ayikwazi ukuvula i-HEIC okwangoku. Isisombululo esilula kukuba uguqule i-HEIC ibe yi-JPG.

Nge-I Need Convert, ungakwenza oku ngqo kwibrawuza. Iifoto azilayishwa kuyo nayiphi na iseva, ngoko zihlala zizimele.

Yintoni i-HEIC?

I-HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) luhlobo lomfanekiso lwale mihla olusetyenziswa yi-Apple ukususela kwi-iOS 11. Olu hlobo lugcina iifoto ngobukhulu obuphantse ukuba bubuhhafu be-JPG, lusixhasa iifoto ze-Live kunye nobunzulu bemibala ephezulu. Ngelishwa, inkxaso yalo ayikabi ngaphi kuyo yonke indawo.

Indlela Yokuguqula i-HEIC ibe yi-JPG

  1. Vula i-ineedconvert.com kwibrawuza yefowuni okanye yelaptop yakho.
  2. Cofa u-Khetha Ifayile, uze ukhethe ifoto enye okanye ezininzi ze-HEIC kunye.
  3. Kwifayile nganye, khetha ifomathi ye-JPG kuluhlu oluwayo.
  4. Cofa u-Guqula okanye u-Guqula zonke.
  5. Iifoto ze-JPG ziyakhutshelwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwisixhobo sakho.

Icebiso: Ufuna imvelaphi ecacileyo? Khetha i-PNG. Ufuna ifayile encinci kakhulu yokuthumela ngetshati? Khetha i-WEBP.

Ukuze i-iPhone Igcine i-JPG Ngqo

Ukuba ufuna i-iPhone ithathe iifoto ngqo nge-JPG, yiya kwi-Useto → Ikhamera → Iifomathi, uze ukhethe u-Ehambelana Kakhulu. Iifoto ezilandelayo ziya kugcinwa njenge-JPG, kodwa ubukhulu bazo buya kuba bukhulu kancinci.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ingaba umgangatho wefoto uyancipha?

Umahluko awubonakali. I-JPG igcinwa kumgangatho we-92%, ophezulu ngokwaneleyo ukuprintwa okanye ukulayishwa kumajelo osasazo loluntu.

Ndingaguqula iifoto ezininzi kunye?

Ungakwazi. Khetha okanye utsalele zonke iifoto kwibhokisi yomguquli, uze ucofe u-Guqula zonke.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.title: Indlela Yokuguqula Ividiyo ibe yi-MP3 Ngaphandle kweApp
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.excerpt: Thatha isandi kwividiyo ye-MP4, i-MOV okanye i-MKV uze usigcine njenge-MP3 yomgangatho we-192 kbps. Simahla, ngokukhawuleza, kwaye ngqo kwibrawuza.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.body:
Ngamanye amaxesha ufuna isandi kuphela: irekhodi yentetho, i-podcast yevidiyo, ukuziqhelanisa nomculo, okanye irekhodi yentlanganiso. Endaweni yokufaka iapp eyongezelelweyo, ungakwazi ukuguqula ividiyo ibe yi-MP3 ngqo kwi-I Need Convert.

Amanyathelo

  1. Vula iphepha lomguquli uze ucofe u-Khetha Ifayile.
  2. Khetha ividiyo (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, nezinye).
  3. Kuluhlu lweefomathi, khetha i-MP3.
  4. Cofa u-Guqula uze ulinde ibha yenkqubela igqibe.
  5. Ifayile ye-MP3 ihlala ngoko nangoko kwifolda yeZikhutshelweyo.

Xa uguqula ividiyo okanye isandi okokuqala, ibrawuza kufuneka ilayishe injini yokuguqula eyi-30 MB malunga. Emva koko, uguqulo olulandelayo luya kukhawuleza kakhulu.

Khetha Ifomathi Yesandi Efanelekileyo

  • MP3: ehambelana kakhulu, idlala kuyo nayiphi na isixhobo.
  • M4A / AAC: ubungakanani obuncinci kunye nomgangatho omhle, ilungele i-iPhone. Kwividiyo ye-MP4, isandi sinokukhutshelwa ngaphandle kokuphinda sikhowudwe, ngoko siphantse sibe sisiquphe.
  • WAV / FLAC: ngaphandle koxinzelelo olonakalisa umgangatho, ilungele ukulungiswa.
  • OPUS / OGG: isebenza kakuhle kakhulu kwilizwi lencoko.

Icebiso: Kwirekhodi yelizwi oya kuyilungisa kwakhona, yigcine kuqala njenge-WAV, uze uyiguqule ibe yi-MP3 emva kokugqiba ukuyilungisa.

Sebenzisa Ngobulumko

Qinisekisa ukuba unelungelo kwividiyo oyiguqulayo. Kumxholo woomnye abantu, usebenzise kuphela kwiinjongo zobuqu kwaye uzihlonele iilungelo zokushicilela zomenzi.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.title: Indlela Yokuguqula i-PDF ibe yi-Word (DOCX) Simahla Nangokukhuselekileyo
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.excerpt: Guqula isicatshulwa esiphakathi kwi-PDF sibe lixwebhu le-Word elinokuhlelwa. Akukho ngxelo, akukho watermark, kwaye ifayile ayilayishwa kwiseva.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.cap1: Incwadi yamanqaku kunye nepeni etafileni yomsebenzi.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.body:
I-PDF yamnandi ukuyifunda nokuyabelana, kodwa nzima ukuyihlela. Ukuba kufuneka uthathe umxholo we-PDF ukuze uyihlele kwakhona, eyona ndlela ikhawulezayo kukuba uguqule i-PDF ibe yi-Word (DOCX).

Indlela Yokuguqula i-PDF ibe yi-DOCX

  1. Vula i-I Need Convert uze ukhethe ifayile ye-PDF.
  2. Khetha ifomathi ye-DOCX.
  3. Cofa u-Guqula, uze uvule iziphumo kwi-Microsoft Word, Google Docs, okanye i-WPS.

Isicatshulwa sephepha ngalinye siyathathwa size silungiswe kwakhona libe ziingqungquthela ezinokuhlelwa ngoko nangoko.

Izinto Ekufuneka Uzazi

  • I-PDF eskeniweyo iqulethe imifanekiso, hayi isicatshulwa. Kwi-PDF enjalo, isicatshulwa asinakuthathwa ngaphandle kwe-OCR.
  • Uyilo oluntsonkothileyo olufana neekholam ezininzi, iitheyibhile, nemifanekiso alusoloko lulandela. Ugxininiso lolu guqulo ngu-mxholo wesicatshulwa.
  • Ukuba ufuna isicatshulwa esiqhelekileyo kuphela, khetha ifomathi ye-TXT.

Icebiso: Ufuna ukugcina indlela i-PDF ebonakala ngayo ngqo njengoko injalo? Guqula i-PDF ibe yi-PNG okanye i-JPG, umfanekiso omnye ephepheni ngalinye. Isikhokelo sikwinqaku elithi indlela yokuguqula i-PDF ibe ngumfanekiso.

Kutheni Kukhuselekile Ngakumbi?

Amaxwebhu afana neekontraka, iislipi zomvuzo, okanye amakhadi achonga umntu akufuneki alayishwe kumasayithi angaqhelekanga. Kwi-I Need Convert, yonke into yenzeka kwisixhobo sakho, ngoko ixwebhu alishiyi ifowuni okanye ilaptop yakho.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.title: Indlela Yokuguqula i-PDF ibe Ngumfanekiso we-JPG okanye we-PNG
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.excerpt: Ipheji nganye ye-PDF iba ngumfanekiso omnye ocacileyo. Khuphela omnye ngamnye okanye zonke kunye kwifayile enye ye-ZIP.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.body:
Ukuthumela i-PDF ngetshati ngamanye amaxesha kuyaphazamisa kuba ofumana kufuneka avule enye iapp. Ukuguqula i-PDF ibe ngumfanekiso kwenza ukuba umxholo ubonwe ngoko nangoko, wabelwane kwisitatasi, okanye wongezwe kwintetho yokuqhubela phambili.

Amanyathelo

  1. Vula i-I Need Convert uze ukhethe ifayile ye-PDF.
  2. Khetha ifomathi ye-JPG, i-PNG, okanye i-WEBP.
  3. Cofa u-Guqula.
  4. Khuphela ipheji nganye, okanye ucofe u-Khuphela zonke ukugcina onke amaphepha kwi-ZIP enye.

Amaphepha enziwa ngesisombululo esiphindwe kabini, ngoko isicatshulwa sihlala sicacile xa sikhulisiwe.

I-JPG, i-PNG, okanye i-WEBP?

  • JPG: ubungakanani obuncinci, ilungele amaxwebhu anemifanekiso okanye ukuthunyelwa ngetshati.
  • PNG: icace kakhulu kwisicatshulwa nakwigrafikhi, kodwa ubungakanani bukhulu.
  • WEBP: ukuvumelana okuhle kakhulu phakathi kokucaca nobungakanani.

Usadideka? Funda umahluko phakathi kwe-JPG, i-PNG, ne-WEBP.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.title: Umahluko phakathi kwe-JPG, i-PNG, ne-WEBP: Khetha Ifomathi Yomfanekiso Efanelekileyo
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.excerpt: Nini ukusebenzisa i-JPG, nini i-PNG, nini i-WEBP? Yazi izinto ezintle neziphene zenye nenye ukuze imifanekiso ihlale icace kwaye ilula.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.body:
Ifomathi yomfanekiso efanelekileyo inokwenza ifayile ibe ncinci kakhulu ngaphandle kokubonakala ngokwahlukileyo. Nanku umahluko phakathi kweefomathi ezintathu ezisetyenziswa rhoqo.

JPG

I-JPG isebenzisa uxinzelelo lwe-lossy, oko kuthetha ukuba ezinye iinkcukacha ziyalahlwa ukuze ifayile ibe ncinci. Ilungele kakhulu iifoto, kodwa ayilunganga kwisicatshulwa, iilogo, okanye izikrini kuba imiphetho inokubonakala ingaqondakali. I-JPG ayixhasi mvelaphi icacileyo.

PNG

I-PNG isebenzisa uxinzelelo lwe-lossless, ngoko akukho nkcukacha ilahlekayo. Lolona khetho lulungileyo kwi-izikrini, iilogo, iicon, nemifanekiso enemvelaphi ecacileyo. Isiphene kukuba iifayile zeefoto kwi-PNG zinokuba zinkulu kakhulu.

WEBP

I-WEBP yifomathi yale mihla evela kwi-Google exhasa uxinzelelo lwe-lossy nolwe-lossless, kunye nokucaca. Ubungakanani bayo budla ngokuba ngaphantsi kwe-JPG nge-25–35% kumgangatho ofanayo. Ilungele iwebhsayithi nokuthunyelwa ngetshati.

Isishwankathelo

  • Iifoto zokuprinta okanye zokuthumela: JPG.
  • Iilogo, iicon, izikrini: PNG.
  • Imifanekiso yewebhsayithi: WEBP.
  • Icon yewebhsayithi (favicon): ICO.

Icebiso: Zonke iifomathi ezingentla zinokuguqulelwa enye kwenye kwi-I Need Convert, kuquka ukusuka kwi-HEIC, i-BMP, i-TIFF, ne-SVG.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.title: Indlela Yokuguqula i-MOV ibe yi-MP4 Ngaphandle Kokunciphisa Umgangatho
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.excerpt: Ividiyo ye-MOV evela kwi-iPhone okanye kwikhamera ayidlali kuzo zonke izixhobo? Yiguqule ibe yi-MP4 ngemizuzwana ngaphandle kokuphinda ikhowudwe.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.body:
I-MOV yifomathi yevidiyo esekwe kwi-iPhone nakumakhamera amaninzi. Ngelishwa, ezinye iiapp, iiTV, namasayithi ayikuxhasi. I-MP4 yeyona fomathi ikhuselekileyo kuba idlala phantse kuyo yonke indawo.

Indlela Yokuguqula i-MOV ibe yi-MP4

  1. Vula i-I Need Convert uze ukhethe ividiyo ye-MOV.
  2. Khetha ifomathi ye-MP4.
  3. Cofa u-Guqula, uze ulinde ide igqibe.

Kutheni Inokukhawuleza Kangaka?

I-MOV ne-MP4 ziyiyo kanye "iingqayi" kuphela. Okuphakathi, oko kukuthi ividiyo ye-H.264/HEVC nesandi se-AAC, kudla ngokufana. I-I Need Convert iqala ngokuzama ukudlulisela umjelo wevidiyo kwingqayi entsha ngaphandle kokuphinda ikhowude. Isiphumo siphantse sibe sisiquphe kwaye umgangatho ufana ngo-100% nowoqobo.

Ukuba umxholo wevidiyo awuhambelani nengqayi ekulindeleke ukuba ifike kuyo, ividiyo iyaphinda ikhowudwe ngokuzenzekelayo nge-H.264 ukuze isadlala.

Icebiso: Indlela efanayo isebenza kwi-MKV ukuya kwi-MP4, i-MP4 ukuya kwi-MOV, ne-TS ukuya kwi-MP4.

Ezinye Iifomathi Zevidiyo

  • WEBM: ilungele iiwebhsayithi.
  • MKV: ixhasa iisubtitle ezininzi neethrekhi zesandi.
  • GIF: yeeanimeshini ezimfutshane ezingenasandi. Jonga indlela yokwenza i-GIF kwividiyo.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.title: Indlela Yokuguqula i-Excel (XLSX) ibe yi-CSV, i-JSON, Nangokuguqukayo
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.excerpt: Guqula ifayile ye-Excel ibe yi-CSV ukuze ifakwe kwezinye iiapp, okanye i-CSV ibe yi-XLSX ukuze ivuleke ngococeko kwi-Excel. Zonke iishiti ziyaguqulwa.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.body:
Iiapp ezininzi, ukusuka kwiivenkile ze-intanethi ukuya kwisoftwe yezemali, zicela idatha ngefomathi ye-CSV. Kwelinye icala, iifayile ze-CSV zilula ukusebenza nazo xa ziguqulelwe kwi-XLSX. Ungakwenza zombini kwi-I Need Convert.

I-Excel ukuya kwi-CSV

  1. Khetha ifayile ye-XLSX, i-XLS, okanye i-ODS.
  2. Khetha ifomathi ye-CSV.
  3. Cofa u-Guqula. Ukuba ifayile inamashiti amaninzi, ishiti nganye ibe yifayile enye ye-CSV, kwaye zonke zinokukhutshelwa njenge-ZIP.

I-CSV igcinwa nge-UTF-8 BOM, ngoko oonobumba abafana ne-é okanye i-ü bubonakala ngokuchanekileyo xa buvulwa kwi-Excel.

I-CSV ukuya kwi-Excel

Khetha ifayile ye-CSV okanye i-TSV, uze ukhethe i-XLSX, i-XLS, okanye i-ODS.

Isipredishithi ukuya kwi-JSON

Kubaphuhlisi, khetha ifomathi ye-JSON. Umqolo ngamnye uba yiobjekthi enye enamagama eekholam njengezitshixo. Kwelinye icala, iifayile ze-JSON, i-YAML, okanye i-XML zinokuguqulelwa kwi-CSV okanye i-XLSX.

Icebiso: Iifomyula ze-Excel azihambi kwi-CSV, ziyahamba kuphela amaxabiso eziphumo zokubala. Gcina nefayile yoqobo ye-XLSX ukuba usazidinga iifomyula.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.title: Indlela Yokwenza i-GIF kwividiyo Ngokulula
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.excerpt: Guqula isiqwenga sevidiyo sibe yi-GIF ehambayo edlala phindaphinda. Ubungakanani obulula, imibala isahleli intle, ngqo kwibrawuza.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.body:
I-GIF isengoyona ndlela ilula yokwabelana ngeeanimeshini ezimfutshane: iimpendulo ezihlekisayo, amanyathelo omqulu wokufundisa, okanye imiboniso yeapp. Ungakwazi ukwenza i-GIF kwividiyo ye-MP4, i-MOV, i-WEBM, nezinye.

Amanyathelo

  1. Lungiselela ividiyo emfutshane, ngokufanelekileyo engaphantsi kwemizuzwana eyi-10.
  2. Vula i-I Need Convert uze ukhethe ividiyo.
  3. Khetha ifomathi ye-GIF, uze ucofe u-Guqula.

I-GIF yenziwa ngeeframe ezili-12 ngesekhondi, ububanzi obuphezulu beepixel ezingama-480, kunye nepalethi yemibala ebalwe ngokukhethekileyo kwividiyo yakho. Isiphumo sihlala sicacile ngobungakanani obufanelekileyo.

Amacebiso Okugcina i-GIF Ilula

  • Sebenzisa ividiyo emfutshane. Ubude bunefuthe elikhulu kakhulu kubungakanani befayile.
  • Phepha ividiyo enentshukumo yekhamera emininzi.
  • Ukuba i-GIF isakhulu kakhulu, cinga nge-WEBM okanye i-MP4. Ubungakanani bunokuba ngaphantsi ngamaxesha ali-10 kwaye zisaya kudlala ngokuzenzekelayo kwiiplatifomu ezininzi.

I-GIF ukuya kwividiyo

Kwelinye icala, i-GIF inokuguqulelwa kwi-MP4 okanye i-WEBM. Ilungele ukulayishwa kwiiplatifomu ezingayamkeliyo i-GIF.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.title: Ingaba Ukuguqula Iifayile Kwi-intanethi Kukhuselekile? Nantsi Into Ekufuneka Uyazi
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.excerp: Abaguquli abaninzi be-intanethi balayisha ifayile yakho kwiiseva zabo. Yazi iingozi kunye nendlela yokuguqula amaxwebhu abalulekileyo ngokukhuselekileyo.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.body:
Abaguquli be-intanethi bayasebenziseka, kodwa uninzi lusebenza ngokuba lulayishe ifayile kwiseva, luyiphathe apho, luze lubuyisele iziphumo. Kwiifoto zeholide mhlawumbi akukho ngxaki, kodwa kuthekani ngekhadi lesazisi, ikontraka yomsebenzi, okanye idatha yabathengi?

Iingozi Zokulayisha Ifayile

  • Ifayile inokugcinwa kwiseva ixesha elide kuneleo liphiweyo.
  • Iseva inokuhlaselwa ngabaphandi bokuqhekeza kwaye iifayile zivuzwe.
  • Awazi ukuba ngubani onokufikelela kuloo fayile.
  • Ukulayisha nokukhuphela iifayile ezinkulu kusebenzisa idatha kunye nexesha.

I-I Need Convert Yahluke Njani?

I-I Need Convert iqhuba onke amaguqulelo ngaphakathi kwibrawuza yakho. Ifayile ifundwa kwaye iphathwe sisixhobo sakho, uze umphumo ugcinwe ngqo kwifolda yeZikhutshelweyo. Akukho fayile ethunyelwa kwiseva yethu.

Inzuzo eyongezelelweyo: kuba akukho kulayisha, ukuguqulwa kwemifanekiso namaxwebhu kunokugqitywa ngemizuzwana.

Amacebiso Okuguqula Amaxwebhu Ngokukhuselekileyo

  • Sebenzisa umguquli ophatha iifayile endaweni yasekhaya kumaxwebhu abucayi.
  • Cima iifayile eziguqulweyo kwifolda yeZikhutshelweyo xa zingasafuneki.
  • Phepha ukuguqula amaxwebhu abalulekileyo kwiikhompyutha zoluntu.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.e: Isiphumo soguqulo asivuleki okanye asidlali? Nazi izizathu eziqhelekileyo kunye nendlela yokuzilungisa.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.b:
Ngamanye amaxesha, ifayile eguqulweyo ayivuleki kwezinye iiapp. Ngokuqhelekileyo isizathu asikokuba ifayile yonakele, kodwa kukuba iapp ayiyixhasi ifomathi leyo. Nazi iimeko eziqhelekileyo.

1. Iapp Ayiyixhasi Ifomathi

Iifomathi ezifana ne-WEBP, i-AVIF, i-OPUS, okanye i-MKV azixhaswa zonke iiapp ezindala. Isisombululo kukukhetha ifomathi eqhelekileyo ngakumbi: i-JPG yemifanekiso, i-MP3 yesandi, kunye ne-MP4 yevidiyo.

2. Ividiyo Eguqulwe Ngaphandle Kokuphinda Ikhowudwe

Xa kuguqulwa ingqayi yevidiyo, umzekelo i-MKV ibe yi-MP4, umjelo wevidiyo ukhutshelwa njengoko unjalo. Ukuba ividiyo yoqobo isebenzisa ikhowudeki ye-HEVC (H.265), ezinye izixhobo ezindala azinakuyidlala. Zama ukuguqula ibe yi-WEBM okanye i-AVI ezihlala zikhowudwa kwakhona, okanye uyidlale nge-VLC.

3. Ifayile Ayigqibanga Ukukhutshelwa

Kwiifayile ezinkulu, linda de ukukhuphela kwibrawuza kugqibe ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuyivula.

4. Isicatshulwa se-PDF Singenanto Xa Siguqulelwa kwi-DOCX okanye i-TXT

Kunokwenzeka ukuba loo PDF yaskenwa, ngoko umxholo wayo ngumfanekiso. Yiguqule ibe yi-JPG okanye i-PNG ukugcina umxholo.

5. Oonobumba Abangaqhelekanga Kwi-CSV

Qinisekisa ukuba uvula i-CSV ngekhowudi ye-UTF-8. Iifayile ze-CSV ezivela kwi-I Need Convert sele ziqulethe uphawu lwe-UTF-8 ukuze i-Excel izifunde ngokuchanekileyo.

Usenengxaki? Funda neli nqaku elithi umahluko phakathi kwe-JPG, i-PNG, ne-WEBP ukuze ukhethe ifomathi elungileyo.
